title: fix: rebalance app quests around paid usage
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Retires the first-user connection quest while preserving earned rewards and claim history.
- Reduces the ten-connected-users reward from 15 to 3 Pollen.
- Activates the 10-Paid-Pollen app milestone for 3 Pollen, with progress. Counts only successful billed external Paid usage; excludes Quest Pollen and owner usage. First Paid request remains 15 Pollen.
- Verified: 39 quest tests, TypeScript, Biome, and a 50-row Tinybird SQL fixture covering thresholds and exclusions.
- Before production activation: deploy Tinybird to staging, backfill historical paid consumption and verify existing totals, then repeat in production before deploying Enter. A column-only ALTER is insufficient. No D1 migration or existing-reward changes.

gist.headline: Quests Follow Real Pollen
gist.blurb: App quests now watch for real paid usage, not just a growing contact list. The first successful paid request still gets a generous little pollen shower; the hive has simply given the milestones a better ruler.
gist.summary: Rebalanced app-growth quests by retiring the first-user connection milestone, changing the 10-connected-users reward from 15 to 3 Pollen, and adding a tracked 3-Pollen milestone for 10 successful billed external Paid-Pollen requests while preserving existing rewards and claim history.
gist.impact: App builders can now earn progress toward a 10-Paid-Pollen milestone from successful external billed usage, excluding Quest Pollen and owner usage, while the first paid request continues to reward 15 Pollen.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy app-growth garden where Polli uses a tiny gardener's measuring tool to mark a flowering milestone plant labeled with paid Pollen tokens, while a small retro terminal counts only verified external payments. A faded old connection-counter sign sits peacefully to one side, representing the retired connection quest without making the scene feel punitive.
